## Checklist

- [ ] `go test -race ./...` passes
- [ ] `golangci-lint run` and `golangci-lint fmt` are clean
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]` (if user-visible)
- [ ] Breaking change: the commit type carries a `!` and the changelog says so
- [ ] Docs in `docs/` updated (if behaviour or API changed)
